messages:
alice_rm: Starting staged shift: bump canary from 5% -> 15% now for prod-edge clusters. Change window 60m. @deploy-bot run `shift --id=canary-2026-03-21 --to=15%`
deploy-bot: Received command, starting canary shift. Rolling traffic to canary (15%) across regions: us-west, eu-west, ap-south — step 1/3.
```
{
  "id": "canary-2026-03-21",
  "target": "15%",
  "status": "in_progress",
  "regions": ["us-west", "eu-west", "ap-south"]
}
```
frank_sre: seeing small p95 bump in eu-west (~+120ms) since the shift started. no increase in 5xx yet but latency tail is up. anyone else?
maria_eng: looking at model-variant logs — no 5xx, but KV cache miss rate in eu-west jumped ~3. could be cold edge nodes not warmed.
lena_oncall: pulling traces now. if p95 > 200ms for 2 consecutive mins we should pause. @alice_rm want to pause now or watch for 1 more minute?
josh_prod: stakeholder note — prefer to pause and stabilize. Can we pin back to 5% while we investigate? :thinking_face:
alice_rm: Ok, cautious approach. pause the ramp. @deploy-bot `pause --id=canary-2026-03-21`
deploy-bot: Pause accepted. Current aggregate canary traffic: 11% (regions rolling). Details:
```
{
  "id": "canary-2026-03-21",
  "status": "paused",
  "current_percent": "11%",
  "notes": "paused by alice_rm due to eu-west p95 increase"
}
```
frank_sre: I vote pin/rollback to 5% for now. If we can't find root in 30m, escalate to full rollback.
maria_eng: Agree. Quick mitigations: revert kernel selection for that variant on eu-west, or pin to previous model v2.1.1. Which is fastest to restore latency?
lena_oncall: pin to v2.1.1 via routing override is fastest. I'll run it. @deploy-bot `pin --id=canary-2026-03-21 --version=v2.1.1 --scope=eu-west`
deploy-bot: Pin command acknowledged. Applying routing override for eu-west...
```
{
  "action": "pin",
  "id": "canary-2026-03-21",
  "version": "v2.1.1",
  "regions": ["eu-west"],
  "result": "success",
  "new_canary_percent": "5%"
}
```
alice_rm: Thanks team. Canary traffic restored to 5% and pinned to v2.1.1 in eu-west. No full rollback required for now. I'll update the rollout doc and send a short stakeholder note. reconvene in 30m to decide next steps. :thumbsup:
josh_prod: Writing the stakeholder blurb now — will include that we paused due to p95 increase and pinned model to v2.1.1.
